title: Implementing flexible enhanced buffering for your content

segments.source: Implementing flexible enhanced buffering for your content
segments.ko: Implementing flexible enhanced buffering for your content

segments.source: **Framework**: AVFoundation
segments.ko: **Framework**: AVFoundation

segments.source: Configure your app for flexible enhanced buffering to stream content faster to AirPlay-enabled devices and supported CarPlay vehicles.
segments.ko: Configure your app for flexible enhanced buffering to stream content faster to AirPlay-enabled devices and supported CarPlay vehicles.

segments.source: Overview
segments.ko: Overview

segments.source: If you’re working with content that requires flexibility with buffering, use the [`AVSampleBufferAudioRenderer`](avsamplebufferaudiorenderer.md) and [`AVSampleBufferRenderSynchronizer`](avsamplebufferrendersynchronizer.md) classes.
segments.ko: If you’re working with content that requires flexibility with buffering, use the [`AVSampleBufferAudioRenderer`](avsamplebufferaudiorenderer.md) and [`AVSampleBufferRenderSynchronizer`](avsamplebufferrendersynchronizer.md) classes.

segments.source: To implement flexible enhanced buffering, complete the following steps.
segments.ko: To implement flexible enhanced buffering, complete the following steps.

segments.source: Create a serialization queue to perform all playback operations on, and create the audio renderer and the render synchronizer to establish the media timeline.
segments.ko: Create a serialization queue to perform all playback operations on, and create the audio renderer and the render synchronizer to establish the media timeline.

segments.source: Observe when the renderer has flushed enqueued audio, such as when the rate of playback increases or decreases, and re-enqueue audio data starting from the time the flush occurred.
segments.ko: Observe when the renderer has flushed enqueued audio, such as when the rate of playback increases or decreases, and re-enqueue audio data starting from the time the flush occurred.

segments.source: Add the audio renderer to the render synchronizer, to tell the audio renderer to follow the media timeline.
segments.ko: Add the audio renderer to the render synchronizer, to tell the audio renderer to follow the media timeline.

segments.source:
```swift
renderSynchronizer.addRenderer(audioRenderer)
```
segments.ko:
```swift
renderSynchronizer.addRenderer(audioRenderer)
```

segments.source: Tell the audio renderer to start processing audio data, and set the render synchronizer’s rate to `1` to start playback.
segments.ko: Tell the audio renderer to start processing audio data, and set the render synchronizer’s rate to `1` to start playback.
